comments.author: Kathy
comments.text:
Hi Simon,

In my answer to the question about extreme sports I only referred to rock climbing and free diving. I said that theses sports like many others require from you physical fitness but people doing these sports are willing to take the risk and see how far they can go; to see what is the limit, how much thry can achieve. To thte second part of the question I said that as long as the people doing extreme sports don't pose any danger to the general public they should not be bannned. We should have the freedom to choose for ourselves what we want to do.

comments.text:
Hello Simon,

Referring to Kathy's comment, how should we answer "what is your favorite way to travel"? Three ways of answering this question popped up in my mind, and I'm not sure which one is the correct one.

1. travel alone or travel with friends 2. long holidays or short holidays 3. by plane or by other means of transport (maybe way nearer places)
